" ) def display_user_profile(fullname: str, biography: str, current_status: str) -> str: """ Render a user's profile for web display. All user-provided input is HTML-escaped to prevent injection attacks (CWE‑74). The function returns a sanitized string that can be safely embedded in an HTML document. Parameters: fullname (str): The user's name. biography (str): A multi‑sentence biography written by the user. current_status (str): A brief status update. Returns: str: The formatted, sanitized profile HTML. """ # Escape all user input to neutralize special characters that could alter markup safe_fullname = html.escape(fullname, quote=True) safe_biography = html.escape(biography, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(current_status, quote=True) # Insert escaped values into the template profile_html = PROFILE_FORMAT.format( fullname=safe_fullname, biography=safe_biography, current_status=safe_status ) return profile_html
